and to fix screening criteria in case of a large number of applications. It also states that a Computer-Based Test (CBT)/Written Test/Skill Test/Interview may be conducted where required. The exact stages

how_to_apply: Visit the official IGNOU website: www.ignou.ac.in.
Read the detailed advertisement (Advt. No. 69/2026/Admn.) carefully and confirm eligibility (qualification, age, experience).
Register and fill out the Online Recruitment Application Form with accurate details.
Pay the applicable application fee through the integrated online payment gateway.

Take a printout of the submitted application, sign it, attach self-attested copies of relevant documents, and send it to the Recruitment Cell, Room No. 13, Block No. 7, IGNOU, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi-110068 by 12.11.2026.

Candidates may apply for more than one post if they meet the eligibility criteria for each, subject to CBT/test-timing constraints where applicable. Applications submitted through any mode other than online will be rejected, as will incomplete applications or those lacking fee/signature/enclosures.
important_instructions: Only citizens of India, or subjects of Nepal/Bhutan, Tibetan refugees (pre-1962), or persons of Indian origin migrated from specified countries (with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India), may apply. Candidates claiming reserved-category benefits must submit the requisite SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PwBD certificate in the prescribed format from a Competent Authority. Candidates already employed with Central/State Government/PSU must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of document verification. All original certificates (age, qualification, experience, caste) must be produced at the time of document verification/interview. Experience gained on a part-time, daily-wage, or visiting/guest-faculty basis will not be counted for shortlisting. IGNOU reserves the right to amend, cancel, or modify any part of the recruitment process at any stage. For queries, candidates can email: [email protected].

Note: This article is based only on the details available in the provided official notification. Any information not specified there (such as the detailed selection-test syllabus or exact salary in-hand) has been noted as "not specified" rather than assumed.

content_sections.text: Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU), Maidan Garhi, New Delhi has released the IGNOU Recruitment 2026 notification for the recruitment of Assistant Director, Technical Manager and Technical Assistant posts. The recruitment is being conducted through online applications, with the online registration process scheduled from 03 October 2026 to 02 November 2026. content_sections.heading: IGNOU Vacancy 2026: Post-wise and Category-wise Details
IGNOU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The common essential qualification across all posts is B.E/B.Tech (CS/IT), M.Sc (CS/IT), or MCA from a recognized University/Institute with 55% marks or equivalent grade. Additional working-knowledge requirements apply for Assistant Director - LMS (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JAVA, MySQL/RDBMS, MongoDB/NoSQL DB, API integration, SSO, app development for Android/iOS, and more - see the official notification for the full list). At least 3 years of relevant working experience in the specific technical domain (LMS, Networking, Animation, Game Design, VR/AR, or AI) in PSUs, Universities, Educational Institutions, GoI organizations, or reputed IT organizations. At least 5 years of relevant working experience in the corresponding technical domain, in similar organizations as above. At least 10 years of relevant working experience in the corresponding technical domain (LMS or Networking), in similar organizations as above. Desirable certifications (e.g., CCNA/CCNP, Moodle Administrator, Unity Certified Professional, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, and others specific to each specialization) are listed in the official notification and give preference but are not mandatory.

faq.question: Q1. What is IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Indira Gandhi National Open University for 14 non-teaching posts — Assistant Director, Technical Manager, and Technical Assistant — under Advertisement No. 69/2026/Admn.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 14 vacancies: 2 Assistant Director, 4 Technical Manager, and 8 Technical Assistant posts across various technical specializations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 02.11.2026 at 23:59:59 hrs. The signed printout with documents must reach the Recruitment Cell by 12.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A B.E/B.Tech (CS/IT), M.Sc (CS/IT), or MCA from a recognized University/Institute with 55% marks or equivalent grade, along with post-specific relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 48 years for Assistant Director, 42 years for Technical Manager, and 37 years for Technical Assistant, as on the closing date, with relaxation as per Government of India rules for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 1,000 for Unreserved/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates and Rs. 500 for SC/ST/PH/Ex-servicemen/Women candidates, payable online.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By visiting www.ignou.ac.in, filling the Online Recruitment Application Form, paying the fee online, and submitting it before the last date, followed by sending a signed printout with documents to the Recruitment Cell.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The University may shortlist candidates based on merit, experience, and a written test/skill test/interview as applicable; the detailed process is not specified in the notification.
